description: It was great to join members of the Orange County Shields for their Annual BBQ. Thank you to President Anthony Laperuta for hosting such a wonderful event and for bringing together so many dedicated members of law enforcement and community leaders. I appreciate the opportunity to spend the evening with those who work every day to keep our communities safe. Thank you for your service, commitment, and support 🇺🇸
